decisions.reason: Primary-source revalidation supporting the already-held R503 generic-rank-zero and fixed-orbit sparsity candidates; no separate reusable structure.

Exact Yoshida/Frey identification plus geometric generic MW rank zero closes the direct section route; the explicit fixed-fiber and displayed positive-rank sequences have only O(sqrt(log B)) / O(sqrt(log X)) height growth. Base-change, exceptional-fiber and uniform-small-point routes remain open gates.

Hostile-audited twist descent proves rank E_F(Q(k))=1 with primitive free generator P; the first nondegenerate 3P family has gcd <=128, physical height degree 20, genus-15 third-face exceptions, bounded multiplicity and exact family growth Theta(B^(1/10)). Family-specific and weaker than the global quarter-power lower.

Records the rational base-change/multisection equivalence, correct Q-form/twisted-Kummer boundary, closed BC1/BC2 tests and growing-multiple Lattes upper. The exceptional Prym locus belongs to existing SR-STR-015; the portable Q-degree-two descent is held separately pending the complete normal-form carrier.
Discovery/reuse evidence for R504; theorem content is carried by audited route artifacts.
Search-stage precursor whose incomplete even-family normal form was explicitly repaired; do not promote the superseded completeness claim.

Repairs the earlier false completeness claim and proves every Q-degree-two map up to source PGL2(Q) conjugacy is split u->-u or nonsplit u->d/u, with fixed fields Q(u^2) and Q(u+d/u) and corresponding rational normal forms.

On the complete split form (Au^2+B)/(Cu^2+D), the reciprocal-lift condition factors exactly as (AB-CD)(AB+CD)(AD+BC)=0; S1 and S3 have Q-rational lifts, S2 does not, and the complementary genus-one quotients have nonzero J on the nondegenerate rational loci. This closes only the reciprocal/commuting-involution mechanism, not all Prym factors.

Reduces the remaining full-split exceptional E0-factor problem to an unbounded-degree Hecke/Humbert-type isogeny-union external theorem gate; finite-field hits are diagnostic only. This is the detailed carrier for the existing R504 exceptional Prym gate card.
